scope: shared progression, save/load, evolution and reincarnation races; AI companion excluded
method: Actual source functions executed in a Node VM with controlled timers, speech additions and in-memory storage; no native runtime or production network.

findings.reproduction: During normal evolution or failed ultimate evolution, continue recognized speech and terminate before the effect completes. Previous code saved the target stage with the previous form.
findings.fix: Commit stage and form together when evolution finishes; recognize an already-awarded ultimate lifetime while its visual effect is pending.

findings.reproduction: Reset during an evolution, then allow the old animation/fallback callback to run. It previously changed the reset character and could restore a pending ultimate award.
findings.fix: Cancel active effect listeners/timers, invalidate callbacks by generation, and clear the pending form switch on reset/reincarnation while preserving the earned collection entry.

findings.reproduction: At the reincarnation deadline, while the three-second darkening is pending, speak or reset and then speak. The old timeout previously reset the new egg a second time and erased the new count.
findings.fix: Invalidate and cancel the pending reincarnation when silent reincarnation or reset occurs; preserve the normal three-second darkening.

migration.behavior: Only a known current form whose saved stage is exactly one step ahead has its stage restored. Form, counts, collections and pending ultimate award are preserved. Unknown/ambiguous cases are unchanged.

additionalValidation: Related gameplay, evolution effect, migration and persistence suites: 72 passed, 0 failed after the review correction. Native runtime and the final release artifact remain external verification gates.
unchanged: Evolution thresholds, selection probabilities, reward amounts, reincarnation duration rules, retained records, audio features and AI companion files.
remaining: Real Android WebView: kill/relaunch during evolution after another recognized phrase.
Real Android device: reset during darkening, reduced motion, background/resume at a reincarnation deadline.
Store-track installation/upgrade of the exact signed artifact.

reviewCorrection.finding: Pending ultimate collection unlock was lost on warm expiry/reset although cold load retained it.
reviewCorrection.fix: Persist collection unlock when awarded; preserve a legacy pending successful collection entry before cancellation without restoring the form after reset or reincarnation.
